title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-11-16
lineage: aud>?>Rich>nak>nak dolby C> XLII C90, from Rich Petlock; Transfer: Dragon dolby C>UA55>usb> Audacity>TLH>flac16

ai_review.summary: Decent late‑1970 performance with a strong Good Lovin’ jam and clear Jerry, Bob and Phil mix, though Jorma and Jack are missing from the tape.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a solid mid‑70s set where Papa John Creach’s fiddle shines alongside loud, clear parts from Garcia, Weir and Lesh. While the Good Lovin’ jam is highlighted as a high point, the absence of Jorma Kaukonen and Jack Casady in the mix keeps the show from being spectacular, and the overall audio quality is only fair due to those missing elements.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review rates the show as average (3 stars) with clear but incomplete mix; limited data yields a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Jerry, Bob, Phil and Papa John are loud and clear, but Jorma and Jack are absent from the mix, suggesting an incomplete source or poor channel balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set pacing; reviewers only note a strong late‑1970 Good Lovin’ jam and overall OK performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar comes through loud and clear.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh's bass is audible and clear in the mix.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's rhythm guitar/vocals are present and distinct.
band_member_comments.Keys: An electric piano is visible on stage left, but no specific performance comments.
